description:
Our team is excited to tackle the "Abandoned but not Forgotten" challenge! We aim to bring the stories of NASA's historic, discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars back to life through creative storytelling and engaging visuals. 

I am a Software Developer skilled in coding and web development. 

We are looking for creative team members to join us, especially:

- Storytellers / Writers (to craft the narratives)

- Digital Artists / Designers (for visuals/animations)
